categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies src/bitcoin-cli.cpp, which is explicitly covered under RPC as the node's RPC client.
categories.rationale: Fixes two regressions in `bitcoin-cli` HTTP handling where empty-body responses hang indefinitely and `-rpcclienttimeout` prematurely terminates active transfers. Author notes that `Content-Length: 0` responses bypass completion logic to wait on connection closure, and that timeout countdown previously failed to reset on arriving data (PR description).

categories.evidence: The tools category explicitly excludes the node and its RPC client ('Command-line tools other than the node and its RPC client').
categories.rationale: Non-member because the category definition expressly excludes bitcoin-cli.
